subject: value of query is not changing :((

messages.author: b9fcc224e2aebd9b
messages.subject: value of query is not changing :((
parts:
Hi All-

I am new to R and shiny and I want to create a little demo to show a boxplot that changes every time the user choose a different value from a select box. The problem that the value of the query never changes and it keep showing me the same plot :(  Help will be very appreciated thanks

 Here is my code :

server.R

library(shiny)
library(RODBC)

# Define server logic required to plot various variables against mpg
shinyServer(function(input, output) {

q1 <- reactive({

channel <- odbcDriverConnect(connection = "Driver={SQL Server};Server=BONES;Database=changepoint;Trusted_Connection=yes;")

q2 <- reactive({sqlQuery(channel,paste("select c.name,r.name,sum(hours) from time t inner join customer c on t.customerid=c.customerid inner join resources r on r.resourceid=t.resourceid where t.billable=1 and c.name like ",input$variable,"  and year(timedate)=2013 group by month(timedate),c.name,r.name" ))
odbcClose(channel)
})
 
})

 output$caption <- renderText({
   input$variable
  })

 output$rPlot <- renderPlot({
   boxplot(hours~rname, data=q2) 
  })
 
})

ui.R
library(shiny)

# Define UI for miles per gallon application
shinyUI(pageWithSidebar(

  # Application title
  headerPanel("Miles Per Gallon"),

  # Sidebar with controls to select the variable to plot against mpg
  # and to specify whether outliers should be included
  sidebarPanel(
    selectInput("variable", "Variable:",
                list("Value1" = "'val1'", 
                     "Value2" = "'val2'", 
                     "Value3" = "'val3'"))

    
  ),

  # Show the caption and plot of the requested variable against mpg
  mainPanel(
 
h3(textOutput("caption")),
   plotOutput("rPlot")
  )
))

messages.author: 55771919c42cb6a1
messages.subject: Re: value of query is not changing :((
parts:
Part of the problem is that you're defining q2 within q1. Also, q1 will never be executed since it's a reactive expression which isn't called from anywhere else.

I'd suggest reading the three tutorial pages in the section "Understanding Reactivity", starting with:
  http://rstudio.github.io/shiny/tutorial/#reactivity-overview


-Winston
